facts.text: I've been having fevers that come and go.
They've been going on for about a month.
I've lost 7 kg over the past two months.
I was given moxifloxacin for ten days.
It didn't make me any better.
I was also given voriconazole for three days.
That didn't make me better either.
I work in a blood bank.
Recently I did farm work in my home region along the Yangtze River, so I was in contact with soil.

findings.name: abdominal examination
findings.result: Hepatomegaly, 2 cm below the costal margin; splenomegaly, 3 cm below the costal margin.

findings.name: complete blood count
findings.result: Progressive pancytopenia: WBC 1.86 × 10^9/L; hemoglobin 86 g/L; platelets 2 × 10^9/L.

findings.name: viral serology
findings.result: CMV IgM positive; HSV antibodies positive; HIV serology negative.

findings.name: PET-CT
findings.result: Increased glucose uptake in bone marrow and spleen without evidence of malignancy.

gold.reasoning: 1. Lymphoma was considered but excluded — “PET‐CT revealed no malignant tumour, excluding lymphoma.” 2. Tuberculosis was considered but excluded — “no pathogenic evidence of tuberculosis was found, and the PPD and T‐SPOT results were negative.” 3. Penicilliosis was considered in the differential of systemic mycoses — “histoplasmosis and penicilliosis have similar clinical presentations, laboratory findings, and chest radiographic abnormalities… thus, these two kinds of microorganisms should be microbiologically distinguished.”
